title: 2017 Toyota Camry XSE Hood Paint and Grille Replacement
summary: Carcis Autobody Repair repainted the hood and replaced the grille on a 2017 Toyota Camry XSE.
story: This 2017 Toyota Camry XSE came to the shop for front-end paint and body work. The scope of work included repainting the hood and replacing the front grille assembly.

Replacing a front grille involves removing the damaged section, disconnecting attached trim, and securing the new grille unit into place. Proper alignment ensures seamless spacing along the front bumper and headlights.

Repainting the hood requires thorough surface preparation. The panel is sanded, primed, and sprayed with factory-matched black paint. A clear coat is applied and polished to produce a smooth, reflective finish across the entire hood surface.
